keep_kunder4.zh_canonical: 綜合社會保障援助計劃
keep_kunder4.rationale: CSSA is the principal HK means-tested welfare instrument; doctrinally central to social_welfare. Sub-strict count reflects administration via Social Welfare Department policy rather than codification in a single Cap.
Statutorily defined concept in Cap. 57 §31E; integral to severance-payment entitlement. EN attestation (k=3) marginally below gate but doctrinally central.

Canonical antonym of 'strike' in collective-labour doctrine; without it the strike/lockout dyad is asymmetric. EN attestation (k=0) reflects the term being subsumed under generic provisions in Cap. 332, but it remains a doctrinally central category.

drop.rationale: Scientific laboratory ('政府化驗所'), false-friend match on 'lab' string. Unrelated to labor_social domain.
Scientific laboratory ('檢驗所'), false-friend match on 'lab' string. Unrelated to labor_social domain.
Hong Kong Laboratory Accreditation Scheme is a scientific-lab accreditation programme, false-friend match on 'lab'. Unrelated to labor_social domain.
'Non-employer' as 'non-employer trustee' is a marginal MPF compound; redundant given 'employer' (#55) is retained.
k_en=0 k_zh=0; not attested in HK Cap. e-Legislation. Drop per HARD GATE.
Residual Provident Fund Scheme: very low attestation (k=1/1); niche MPF residual category. MPF coverage already provided by 'provident fund' (#205).
Social Security Allowance Scheme: k=0/0, not attested in HK Caps under this exact form. Drop per HARD GATE.
International Labour Conference: k=0/0, exogenous to HK statutes (it is an ILO event, not a HK Cap. instrument).
'Constructive': k_zh=0; morphological adjective. 'Constructive dismissal' is captured under 'dismissal' (#49).
'Gratuity': k_zh=0 below gate; covered substantively by 'long service payment' (#2265). Limited exception budget reserved for higher-priority entries.
'Incapacitate': k_en=1; morphological verb form covered by 'disablement' (#5341).
'Month-to-month': k=1/3 below gate; obscure tenancy-style compound; not central to employment doctrine.
'Parental': k_zh=0; adjective in 'parental leave', niche provision; not in core HK statutory taxonomy.
'Industrial action': k=2/2 below gate; substantively covered by 'strike' (#147) and the lockout/strike dyad.
'Labouring': k=3/3 below gate; morphological derivative of 'labour' (#296).
'Time-rate': k=2/2 below gate; technical wage-rate compound covered by 'wage' (#3630).

promote.rationale: 'pension' is the canonical retirement-benefit category (Cap. 89 Pensions Ordinance, Cap. 426 ORSO). Strict attestation (k=8/8).
'retirement age' is the statutory threshold concept across MPF (Cap. 485 §3) and pension schemes; k=8/8.
'pension fund scheme' is the umbrella category for occupational retirement schemes (Cap. 426 ORSO); k=8/8.
'elderly' is the protected/beneficiary category in social-welfare provisions (Cap. 459 Residential Care Homes (Elderly Persons) Ordinance); k=8/8.
'assistance' is the statutory umbrella term for CSSA and Social Security Allowance regimes administered by the Social Welfare Department; k=8/8.
'nurse' (registered nurse) is a regulated healthcare profession (Cap. 164 Nurses Registration Ordinance); core social-welfare workforce category; k=8/8.
'disability' is the protected characteristic under Cap. 487 Disability Discrimination Ordinance; doctrinally central to the discrimination sub-area.
'breastfeeding' is the protected status under Cap. 480 Sex Discrimination Ordinance (post-2020 amendment) and Cap. 57 nursing-break provisions.
'compensation' is the statutory entitlement under Cap. 282 Employees' Compensation Ordinance; foundational to occupational-injury doctrine.
'injure' is the operative verb in Cap. 282 §5 employees-compensation provisions (k=8/8).
'occupational' is the qualifier in OSH (Cap. 509) and occupational-disease provisions; central modifier across the sub-area.
'workman' is the statutory category in Cap. 282 Employees' Compensation Ordinance §3 (manual workers covered by EC); doctrinally distinct from 'employee'.
'hours of rest' is a statutory entitlement (Cap. 57 §17); foundational working-time concept (k=8/8).
'maternity' is the statutory maternity-leave/protection concept (Cap. 57 Pt III); doctrinally central (k=8/8).
'salary' is a basic remuneration concept distinct from 'wage'; central to MPF contributions (Cap. 485 §2); k=8/8.
'remuneration' is the umbrella term covering wages, salary and benefits, used in Cap. 57 and Cap. 485; k=8/8.
'severance' is the statutory severance-payment concept (Cap. 57 Pt VA), core to termination doctrine (k=8/8).
'worker' is the broader collective-labour subject (Cap. 332 Trade Unions Ordinance), distinct from 'employee'; canonical reference of trade-union membership.

confidence_self_assessment.rationale: Strong attestation gate pass for 27/50 keep_strict and 18/18 promote (all k>=4 in both EN and ZH). The five exception entries are doctrinally central HK labor-law categories (employee, CSSA, trade union, lay-off, lockout) whose sub-strict counts reflect ZH lemma noise or generic-provision subsumption rather than absence of doctrinal centrality. Sub-area distribution is balanced (max=10 per area) with the six brief sub-areas all represented. Main residual concern: the discrimination sub-area is the thinnest (4 entries) because the Cap. 480/487/527/602 protected characteristics rarely surface as bare lemmas in the candidate pool; the discrimination signal is primarily carried by the head term 'discrimination' (#1344) plus the Cap. 487 'disability' anchor and the Cap. 480 'breastfeeding' anchor.

weakest_decisions.concern: lockout: k_en=0 is a strong miss; kept by exception only because the strike/lockout dyad is doctrinally non-decomposable. Worth verifying with a Cap. 332 full-text search whether the canonical EN lemma is rather 'closing' or 'industrial dispute'.

CSSA: k=2/2 is meaningfully below gate; reflects the scheme being SWD-policy rather than Cap-codified. Consider whether 'social security' or 'comprehensive social security' should be promoted instead at next iteration.

disability: knn_confidence=0.57 is the lowest among promotes; the embedding may be ambiguating Cap. 487 (disability discrimination) with Cap. 282 (disablement-as-injury). The sub-area assignment as 'discrimination' relies on Cap. 487 doctrinal centrality.

nurse: confidence=1.00 but the sub_area assignment to 'social_welfare' is conventional; Cap. 164 is regulatory rather than welfare-distributive. Could equally sit in occupational_safety as a workforce category.

Drop of 'laboratory': confident drop (false-friend with 'labour') but flagged for sanity—if any HK Cap. uses '檢驗所' in an OSH/inspection sense (e.g. testing-laboratory inspection of workplaces), the drop may be over-aggressive.

notes: Curation strategy: (i) prune three 'laboratory' false-friend matches that exploit string overlap with 'labour'; (ii) consolidate morphological derivatives ('harass'/'harassment', 'provident'/'provident fund', 'labouring'/'labour'); (iii) drop under-4 entries that are exogenous to HK Caps (ILO Conference, Social Security Allowance Scheme, parental, month-to-month) or substantively redundant ('industrial action' under 'strike', 'time-rate' under 'wage', 'incapacitate' under 'disablement'); (iv) reserve the 5-exception budget for non-substitutable doctrinal anchors (employee, trade union, CSSA, lay-off, lockout); (v) backfill via promotes the six sub-areas to a balanced 4–10 range, prioritising social_welfare (pension/retirement/CSSA), occupational_safety (Cap. 282 vocabulary) and wages_hours_leave (Cap. 57 working-time and remuneration). All keep_strict and promote entries pass the strict gate (k_en≥4 AND k_zh≥4). [PASS-2 OVERRIDE 2026-05-02: zh_clean overridden for 2 gloss-artefact terms; 2 moved keep_kunder4 → keep_strict.]
